title: Sushi-Free is now online
imageAlt: Granite boulder in the Sushi-Free sector
teaser: The Sushi-Free sector is now available with its map, boulders and routes.
text: Sushi-Free has been added to the La Cerra guide. The sector page currently includes nine boulders, the corresponding route information and a detailed sector map.
The overview will continue to grow as descriptions and further information are added.

title: Explore La Cerra from the map
imageAlt: Overview map of the La Cerra bouldering sectors
teaser: The La Cerra overview map now links directly to all eight sector pages.
text: The coloured sector markers and their names can be selected directly on the overview map. This provides a quick route from the general La Cerra page to each individual sector.
A compact sector menu remains available below the map as an alternative way to navigate.

title: Route tracking improvements
teaser: Climbed routes are easier to recognise and manage throughout the guide.
text: Routes already stored in a personal tick list are marked directly on the sector pages. Projects without a confirmed grade cannot be added accidentally.
The profile provides an overview of climbed routes, grades and personal statistics.

title: The sector guide is growing
imageAlt: Granite boulder in the La Sportiva sector
teaser: Additional La Cerra sector pages are ready to receive maps, descriptions and route data.
text: The guide structure now includes Somewhere, La Sportiva, Sushi-Free, Bermuda Triangle, 2nd Life, Stuntblocs, Monte Lu Bagnu and Monte Pulchiana.
The individual pages will be completed step by step as maps, photographs and verified route information become available.
